_meta.description: Census 2011 worker classification (% of total workers) per AP district, resolved from each 2022 district to its undivided-AP Census-2011 parent district. Percentages are scale-invariant so serve as an AC-level proxy (all ACs in a district share the district figure). Source: Census 2011 Primary Census Abstract via nishusharma1608/India-Census-2011-Analysis (india-districts-census-2011.csv).
